name: Local Smoke Tests
objective: Add reproducible local-only smoke tests for Steam Deals Web, PAYDAY 2 Web, and desktop launcher with bounded localhost checks and clean shutdown.
exit_criteria: A local-only placement strategy exists so smoke assets do not get pushed to GitHub by accident.
A minimal Steam Deals Web smoke test exists and checks localhost readiness only.
A minimal PAYDAY 2 Web smoke test exists and checks localhost readiness only.
A minimal desktop or desktop-launcher smoke test exists and avoids external service dependencies.
All smoke tests terminate any started processes cleanly on success, timeout, and failure.
A simple local runner or documented commands make the smoke tests reproducible and easy to execute.
